title: The Works: tier 3 takes longer
lines: Lanterns for the great tree needs all 10 pieces of tier 3 research, not 3, and tier 3 research costs 1.5 times as many Timber folios.
Research you have finished stays finished. Research you are studying keeps the folios it has had.

more.head: Why
points: Played through by the rules, tier 3 took about 1 hour 45 minutes. It is meant to take 4 to 5 hours. It now takes about 4 hours 15 minutes.
